subject.title: Feature: configurable LLM retry with backoff on transient errors (overloaded/529)

question: What public retry contract should OpenClaw expose for main LLM requests before accepting a config/API implementation for #49376?
rationale: The issue asks for new public config and runtime retry semantics that overlap existing session retry, SDK retry caps, auth cooldowns/profile rotation, fallback behavior, cron retry, and idempotency boundaries; automation cannot choose that API safely.

options.title: Settle a single provider/agent retry contract first
options.body: Define the supported config location, retryable classes, backoff limits, status visibility, and interaction with fallback before merging any runtime or schema PR.

options.title: Limit the work to existing session retry
options.body: Expose or document only the existing session retry behavior and reject a separate provider-level retry config if maintainers want fewer public knobs.

options.title: Keep retry policy internal
options.body: Close the feature direction and continue improving fixed failover/session retry behavior without adding a user-configurable LLM retry surface.

recommendation.title: Settle a single provider/agent retry contract first
recommendation.body: Define the supported config location, retryable classes, backoff limits, status visibility, and interaction with fallback before merging any runtime or schema PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent runtime/provider retry work and current-main history make this the strongest available owner for the product/API choice.
